# Kitani Islam Portfolio

Kitani Islam is a lead full-stack engineer with 9+ years of experience building web, mobile, backend, and AI-enabled products across North Africa, Europe, and Asia.

Primary strengths:
- Frontend and mobile product engineering: React, React Native, Next.js, Vue, Astro, TypeScript.
- Backend systems and APIs: Node.js, REST, GraphQL, database design, integrations, authorization, product infrastructure.
- AI integration and RAG workflows: practical AI product features, retrieval workflows, internal tools, automation.
- Technical leadership: mentoring, release planning, code review, product feedback translation, client delivery.

Selected work:
- Rep&Sets: cross-platform training product for coaches and athletes across web, iOS, and Android.
- Fit2Go: prepared-meal ordering product with improved guided meal-plan selection.
- GoLivry: logistics and cash-on-delivery landing experience for Guinea.
